title: 第十一章 思壁村现状第十二章 初识矮仔成
content_zh:
和谈得来的人一起，很能印证爱因斯坦的相对论，感觉时间过得快，两个小时的车程说到就到。
进入银海湾景区，一条滨海公路在山与海之间如蛇般游走，在阳光灿烂的时间里开车走在这种空间里，立即痛恨开的车为什么不是敞篷的，副驾坐的为什不是美女，哦，只有副驾符合要求。
来点轻松愉快的音乐就更好了。
从进入滨海公路开始，生命中曾经的导游属性开始显露，我开始了导游讲解：“银海湾原来是个不起眼的海湾，主要是因为道路难行，我们现在走的这条滨海公路，是五年前在原有的机耕路基础上扩建的，随着各路神仙对海样度假资源的兴趣，银海湾也不例外的给圈了起来，不过还好，没像海南岛那样，环岛走下来，基本上没有了公共属性的海滩。
刚好就在悬崖酒店所在的思壁村村口对出的位置上，可以直接到公共海滩去。
社会资本总是嫌贫爱富的，我说的是资源。
思壁村比较落后，也没资源，还有些脏乱差的底子在，思壁村前面靠海边的土地，因为靠近思壁村，档次拉不上去，各路神仙都不太愿意碰，只是到了最后没有了，才起了那么几栋公寓。
歪打正着的留了片海滩出来，后来管委会便将这里变成了公共性质的海滩。
从思壁村的这悬崖看过去，能看到海，景色也不错。”
紫萱说：“林凡，你的功课做的还不错。
对了，待会儿我们是怎样？”
遇到红绿灯，我将车停了下来：“待会儿去找高个，他叫邹家成，思壁村里最大家族是他叔叔，他这个人还行。”
紫萱问：“现在去哪儿？”
我回答说：“我们要去公共海滩走走。
从那里看思壁村，也是不同的角度，我来了几次，都是在海边思考山边的事。”
助理小陈立即俏皮的唱了起来：“在那山的那边海的那边有一群蓝精灵…”
，紫萱还以一句：“还唱啊？格格巫正在录像呢！”
我和小陈几乎都异口同声的说了句：“啥？这一路都在录吗？”
紫萱得意了起来：“当然啦！
应验这个格格巫还是很会选择什么时候开机录制的。”

说话间，我已经将车开到了公共海滩边上的停车场了，海滩免费，停车不免费，而且收费还不含糊。
小陈听了听过停车场收费的价格，直呼牙疼。
嗯，没错，你所享受免费的，其实是在另一个方面让你破费了的。
大家下了车，舒展了一下腿脚，她们几个都伸展了一下身体，看上去坐车的比开车的还累，真是日了狗了。
应验是个帅小伙，对摄影有着天然的敏感。
他下车整理了一下，提着一个箱子过来，说：“林凡，你说的思壁村就在对面是吧？是那座山吗？”
他指了指我身后不远处横亘在滨海大道那一头的山岗，从海滩角度看去，思壁村确实是属于面壁思过的那种背影，不但不出众，还很矮小，蜷缩在银海湾的一角，真像个可怜兮兮的孩子。
我嗯的一声，然后问应验：“你带无人机过来了？电视台的果然是高大上设备呀！”
应验说：“不是电视台的，我自己的装备啦！”
边说边打开箱子，手脚利索的做着无人机起飞前的准备。
另一边，三斤姐在为紫萱画个淡妆，小陈在旁边协助着，只有好像没有我什么事，我在回想昨天的问题提纲该怎么回答，但是似乎海风把我昨天思考好的答都吹走了，没什么头绪，可能是昨晚的那个梦让我有点畏缩，虽然只是梦，但是梦得这么真切，包括我的处理手法都是如此吻合我现在的性格，有时候我遇到事情要处理又怕处理的时候，确实会采用那样的鸵鸟态度，总以为将头埋下去一会儿装作看不见就真的看不见了，自欺欺人。
紫萱的一袭长裙，在海风的轻轻吹抚下，让她整个人都美丽动人。
三斤姐也是一个极为敬业的人，只要工作起来，就是全神贯注，她的这种专注，从小学的时候就是这样的，要做一件事不难，要做好一件事也不难，要坚持做好一件事就很难，三斤姐热爱这项化妆事业，每每看到自己化妆笔下的轻与重、浓与淡的巧妙融合，变成过目不忘的妆容时，她都会有满满的成就感。
应验开始试飞无人机，我凑了过去看，无人机的角度拍摄出来的画面，简直就是震撼的大场面，尤其是从建筑物上方掠过时候的镜头，动感十足，看着镜头里的景物，仿佛自己就像一只快乐顽皮的鸟儿，调戏着地面上的一切，时而低空掠过，时而冲向云霄，时而俯冲下来，真真一个天高任鸟飞。
应验看着屏幕里的场景，对紫萱说：“紫萱姐，你试试一个人走在海边朝海那边望过去的动作，我现在用无人机拍摄。
哦，最好戴一顶草帽。”
content_en:
Being with someone you can talk to is a great way to confirm Einstein's theory of relativity. It feels like time flies by, and the two-hour drive is just around the corner.
Entering the Yinhai Bay Scenic Area, a coastal road snakes like a snake between the mountains and the sea. When driving in this kind of space on a sunny day, I immediately hate why the car I am driving is not open-top, and why the passenger seat is not a beautiful woman. Oh, only the passenger seat meets the requirements.
Some lighthearted music would be even better.
From the moment we entered the coastal road, the nature of a tour guide in my life began to emerge, and I began to explain: "Yinhai Bay was originally an inconspicuous bay, mainly because the road was difficult to navigate. The coastal road we are taking now was expanded on the basis of the original tractor road five years ago. With the interest of various gods in sea-like vacation resources, Yinhai Bay is no exception. Fortunately, there is no public beach like Hainan Island. Walking around the island, there are basically no public beaches.
It is just opposite the entrance of Sibi Village where the Cliff Hotel is located, and you can go directly to the public beach.
Social capital always dislikes the poor and prefers the rich. I am talking about resources.
Sibi Village is relatively backward, has no resources, and is somewhat dirty. The land in front of Sibi Village is close to the seaside. Because it is close to Sibi Village, the quality is not high enough. The gods are not willing to touch it. It is only in the end that it is gone and only a few apartment buildings have been built.
A piece of beach was accidentally left out, and later the management committee turned it into a public beach.
Looking from the cliff in Sibi Village, you can see the sea and the scenery is not bad. "
Zixuan said: "Lin Fan, you did a good job in your homework.
By the way, what will happen to us later? "
At the traffic light, I stopped the car and said, "I'll go find the tall guy later. His name is Zou Jiacheng. The largest family in Sibi Village is his uncle. He's a pretty good guy."
Zixuan asked: "Where are we going now?"
I replied, “We’re going to go for a walk on the public beach.
Seeing Sibi Village from there is also a different angle. I have been here several times, always thinking about things on the mountainside by the sea. "
Assistant Xiao Chen immediately sang playfully: "There is a group of Smurfs on the other side of the mountain and the sea..."
, Zixuan replied: "Are you still singing? Gargamel is recording the video!"
Xiao Chen and I almost said in unison: "What? Are you recording all the way?"
Zixuan became proud: "Of course!
It turns out that Gargamel is very good at choosing when to start recording. "
While I was talking, I had already driven my car to the parking lot next to the public beach. The beach is free, but parking is not, and the charges are not ambiguous.
Xiao Chen felt a toothache after hearing the prices charged in the parking lot.
Well, that’s right, what you enjoy for free actually costs you money in another aspect.
Everyone got out of the car and stretched their legs and feet. They all stretched their bodies. It seemed that those who were in the car were more tired than those who were driving. They were really tired.
Ying Yu is a handsome young man with a natural sensitivity to photography.
He got out of the car, tidied it up, came over with a box, and said, "Lin Fan, the Sibi Village you mentioned is right across the street, right? Is it that mountain?"
He pointed at the hill that stretched across the coastal road not far behind me. From the perspective of the beach, Sibi Village is indeed the kind of back that faces the wall and thinks about its past. Not only is it not outstanding, it is also very short. It is huddled in the corner of the silver bay, really like a pitiful child.
I hummed, and then asked Yingyi: "Did you bring the drone here? The TV station is really equipped with high-end equipment!"
Fuli said: "It's not from the TV station, it's my own equipment!"
As he spoke, he opened the box and quickly made preparations for the drone to take off.
On the other side, Sister Sanjin is applying light makeup on Zixuan, and Xiao Chen is assisting beside her. It seems that nothing is wrong with me. I am thinking about how to answer the outline of yesterday's question.Answer, but it seems that the sea breeze blew away all the answers I had thought about yesterday, and I have no clue. Maybe it was the dream last night that made me cringe. Although it was just a dream, the dream was so real, including my handling methods, which are so consistent with my current personality. Sometimes when I encounter something that needs to be dealt with but I am afraid of dealing with it, I will indeed adopt that ostrich attitude. I always think that if I bury my head for a while and pretend not to see it, I will really not be able to see it. I deceive myself.
Zixuan's long dress, gently caressed by the sea breeze, made her look beautiful.
Sister Sanjin is also an extremely dedicated person. As long as she works, she is fully focused. Her concentration has been like this since she was in elementary school. It is not difficult to do one thing, and it is not difficult to do one thing well. It is difficult to insist on doing one thing well. Sister Sanjin loves this makeup career. Every time she sees the clever combination of light and heavy, thick and light in her makeup brush, she will have a full sense of accomplishment.
Yingyi started to test the drone, and I got closer to take a look. The pictures captured from the angle of the drone were simply shocking scenes, especially the shots when passing over the buildings. They were full of movement. Looking at the scene in the camera, I felt like a happy and naughty bird, teasing everything on the ground. Sometimes it flew by at low altitude, sometimes it rushed into the sky, and sometimes it swooped down. It was like a bird flying high in the sky.
Yingyi looked at the scene on the screen and said to Zixuan: "Sister Zixuan, try walking alone on the beach and looking towards the sea. I am shooting with a drone.
Oh, and better wear a straw hat. "
